scope: Ski season and article identity checks for Atomic, HEAD, and Salomon records

findings.seasonEvidence: Atomic's current 26/27 Redster catalog/site shows new model/SKU variants; Atomic's official press release states the Q line was renewed for 26/27. These are not interchangeable with the seed's 25/26 records.
findings.decision: Add structured geometry only from matching 25/26 article numbers. Manufacturer catalog gives one representative weight per model, explicitly including plate and binding; record weight only for that reference length. On 2026-10-15, replace the Q7 AASS03668 25/26 seed's mismatched AASS03788 image with a retailer product image whose page title and article match AASS03668, then publish that record; retailer-image display rights remain unconfirmed. Keep Q7.8, Q9, and Q9.8 in draft because their existing image article numbers are 26/27 SKUs. S9 article and image SKU match.
limitations: The manufacturer catalog is preserved as a hosted catalog copy rather than an Atomic-owned domain.

findings.seasonSource: HEAD Hardgoods Workbook 2025/26, manufacturer-authored catalog copy: https://www.skiandbikes.com/image/document/head_workbook_2526_en.pdf

unresolved.decision: The 2025/26 seed follows article 316265 from the HEAD workbook and records only its 163 cm reference geometry. The matching official CDN image path contains article 316265 and returns image/webp. The next-season 26/27 workbook uses article 316266 for EASY JOY R. For 316485, the 25/26 workbook lists PURE JOY R, while an indexed HEAD product-page slug and retailer pages use EASY JOY R; this exact-article naming conflict is unresolved. Exclude its values from 316265. Keep draft because the other four lengths for article 316265 still lack per-size specifications.

The 25/26 HEAD hardgoods workbook and rental handbook identify article 316225 and disagree on the 170 cm radius (12.5 vs 12.4 m); the exact-article retailer also lists 12.4 m at 170 and adds explicit 156 cm (10.5 m) and 163 cm (11.2 m) rows. Add only those two explicitly listed rows, preserve 12.5 m for 170 from the hardgoods workbook, and leave 142, 149 and 177 cm unfilled. The per-length retailer page does not state the season.

findings.decision: Three HEAD 25/26 models have structured size rows from exact-article retailer transcriptions cross-checked against the manufacturer-authored workbook. No weight was inferred. Easy Joy R identity is resolved to article 316265 and its matching official image is recorded, but only its 163 cm geometry is available; article 316485 has conflicting model names between the workbook and product/retailer pages, and 26/27 uses article 316266. Shape V2 R now has explicit 156, 163 and 170 cm rows, while 142, 149 and 177 cm remain unavailable; the 170 cm radius conflict between same-season manufacturer documents remains recorded.

findings.seasonEvidence: Salomon manufacturer-authored FW23/24 Japanese catalog mirror lists QST 92 article L47232400+ and QST 98 article L47232300+ with full size rows. Salomon's current product pages confirm the matching article references; the 26/27 catalog omits both models.
findings.decision: Reclassify both former 2026/27 drafts as 2023/24 historical records, add only catalog-supported per-size geometry, radius, and single-ski weights, and keep draft status. The manufacturer-hosted PDF URL now returns 404; a retailer-hosted copy of the manufacturer-authored catalog provides the tables.
limitations: Do not reuse these older specifications for current QST products without SKU and season matching.
The manufacturer-hosted catalog URL is unavailable; evidence records the mirror limitation.
